notes.title: Update #7
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37198055/6b337557b8d232987044fabf161ce5ae3ecbfa07.png
We prepared new update for you. Mainly it is about some balance and other minor fixes, but there also was added one interesting feature: Now when your weapon is out of ammo, it will be thrown forward to the enemy crowd and damage first enemy, which was on it's way. So no more empty weapons in inventory!

Summary changelog:
Out of ammo weapons now throwable!
Now enemy vehicles will damage you if you "touch" it, so don't!
Rare chests now have more chances to spawn on early game time.
Game camera was moved little more up, now you can see more.
Menu have new tooltips for level interface elements.
Now melee enemies will not "attach" to the player when it is near to him. Previously it was really annoying.
Other fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update #6
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37198055/6b337557b8d232987044fabf161ce5ae3ecbfa07.png
Another one update is here! This update is hotfix for previous one, but also contains some serious changes. All of them listed below:
 Fixed Profile Level problems. Now it works correctly.
 Highscore now is also in Steam Cloud.
 You now can have much more ammo for weapons, it is limited with much bigger cap than before. But now you will receive only half ammo amount from collected weapons than before - just balance thing. Actually you will have more ammo in any case.
 Damage from Additional Damage upgrade is increased from 30% to 100% in max value. Knockback upgrade is also was improved.
 Profile experience, which you receive after game match finish, increased for ~400%. Previously it was really low.
 Shotgun-typed weapons now have more predictable bulles spread. 
 Effects fixes.
 Gamepad menu fixes.

notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37198055/6b337557b8d232987044fabf161ce5ae3ecbfa07.png
Hi! According to new feedback, we released a new update, which will be start platform to other new updates in this direction: was added between-matches progression. Now you can start game not from beginning, but at selected character level, which means you will fight with stronger enemies, find rare weapons and receive some upgrade points at start, according to your level. You can select only levels lower than your profile level, so increasing your profile level now is more important than before. This is why we added cloud saves - your progress will be saved in Steam Cloud and you will never lost it.

So in future updates we'll add a lot of new between-matches progression things, so you will become stronger and stronger with every game match. We aiming to add more rogue-like features to increase game replayability a lot.

Full changelog:
Added Steam Cloud saves - your progress now can be transferred between different PC's using Steam features.
Added between-matches progression.
Added a new weapon - Plasm Shotgun. It is really powerful weapon.
Added weapon change sound - now you will also hear when you change your weapon. 
Minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37198055/6b337557b8d232987044fabf161ce5ae3ecbfa07.png
Hi! We released a new update, primary with tech part changes:
Settings menu now available from running game match too.
Added numeric damage indicators to the game. If you don't like them, you can disable it from settings.
Game settings now synchronized with Steam Cloud between different PC's. Progress will be added to this sync too very soon. It will be important in future updates.
Minor balance fixes and other improvements.

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37198055/6b337557b8d232987044fabf161ce5ae3ecbfa07.png
Released new small update, primary with fixes. Changelog:
Balance improvements.
Bonuses are now easier to take - increased take radius.
Added empty weapon sound - now you can hear when ammo ends without looking on interface.
Minor interface layouts fixes for different languages.

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37198055/6b337557b8d232987044fabf161ce5ae3ecbfa07.png
We received some feedback about game and released today a new update with some gameplay changes:
Added Bonus Crates, which appears on map periodically. From these crates you can get new weapons or healhkits. With game progress you will find rare crates, which contain more items. You can find in crates very rare weapons, so do not forget to search them!
Also added achievement about bonus crates.
Enemies now can jump over small obstacles, so be careful!
Added hit sound, so you can now hear when your attack hit enemies or your character being attacked.
Minor balance fixes and improvements.


Hope you will like new mechanic with Bonus Crates. :)

notes.title: First update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37198055/5a3fea54f87279890d292343259abce53511f87b.png
We released a first update, which includes some balance fixes and improvements:
Level up upgrade points now being earned only on each 5 level, like 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, etc. So now you have max 60 points instead of 300, and now every point give more strength to character.
Start weapons - now you can find some weapons on map after game match start. Previously it can be too hard to play only with knife.
Start help hint is now shown on game match start. It will help new players to understand controls. It is very simple, but some functions like jump not so intuitive.
Minor balance fixes.
